## Scatterplot
```{r, code-chunk, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

data(mtcars) 

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = hp, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
    labs(
      title = "Miles per Gallon vs. Horsepower",
      subtitle = "Data from mtcars dataset",
      x = "Horsepower (hp)",
      y = "Miles per Gallon (mpg)"
    ) +
  theme_classic()
```

## Table
```{r, table, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(mtcars[1:5, 1:5])
```

## Basic Information
<ol>
  <li> The bookdown package is a R package that facilitates writing books and long reports with R Markdown. 
  <li> Bookdown is a markup language used to write elements such as section headers, lists, quotes, figures, tables and citations.
